reading: The multi-coloured pattern at the left edge is copied flush to the right edge, and each row's gap between the two copies is filled with that row's first-column colour.
verb: copy to far edge and bridge

slots.pattern: the left-aligned fg block (full grid height)
slots.copy_place: right-aligned at the grid's last columns
slots.gap_fill: per row, the colour of the pattern's first (= last) column in that row

why: output = input pattern at left + same pattern at right, every background cell between them in a row takes the row's edge colour

reading: Every solid 8-rectangle is repainted: a 2-cell-wide outer band split into quadrants coloured 6 (top-left), 1 (top-right), 2 (bottom-left), 3 (bottom-right), and the inner area coloured 4.

slots.subject: each solid rectangle object
slots.band: cells within 2 of the rectangle's edge, coloured by quadrant: TL 6, TR 1, BL 2, BR 3

why: each rectangle keeps its footprint; colour depends only on cell position within its rectangle

reading: Two opposite border lines have different colours; each isolated 1-cell gets one neighbouring cell, on the side facing the nearer border line, painted that line's colour.

slots.subject: each isolated 1 cell (markers)
slots.border_lines: the two full opposite edge lines of distinct colours
slots.placement: the 4-neighbour of the marker toward the nearer border line

why: every marker gains exactly one adjacent cell coloured as the closer border line, on the side toward it

reading: Each 8-object is shifted right by a distance equal to its own bounding-box width.
why: every object keeps its shape and row; its new left column = old left column + width

reading: Several overlapping, partly hidden octagon rings (6x6 outline) of distinct colours sit on a noisy background; each ring is completed and the rings are stacked vertically in a 6-wide output on the background colour, noise dropped.

slots.subject: each ring colour (excluding the scattered noise colour)
slots.order: rings stacked top to bottom in their layering/position order in the input

why: output is k stacked 6x6 tiles, each the canonical octagon in one ring colour on background

reading: The four cells of the central 2x2 block each move diagonally out to the nearest grid corner.
why: each single-cell object keeps its colour and ends at the grid corner nearest to it; the centre is cleared

reading: Every 3-cell that belongs to a 4-connected group of two or more cells turns 8; lone 3-cells stay 3.

new_rows.name: paired
new_rows.datalog:
paired(Y, X) :- cell(Y, X, C), cell(Y2, X, C), Y2 = Y + 1.
paired(Y, X) :- cell(Y, X, C), cell(Y2, X, C), Y2 = Y - 1.
paired(Y, X) :- cell(Y, X, C), cell(Y, X2, C), X2 = X + 1.
paired(Y, X) :- cell(Y, X, C), cell(Y, X2, C), X2 = X - 1.

why: every fg cell with a same-colour 4-neighbour goes 3 -> 8; nothing else changes (diagonal-only contact does not count)

reading: A vertical and a horizontal line cross; the 8 cells around the crossing become 4, forming a 3x3 ring, while the crossing cell keeps its colour.

new_rows.name: cross
new_rows.datalog: cross(Y, X) :- cell(Y, X, C), cell(Y1, X, A), Y1 = Y - 1, cell(Y2, X, B), Y2 = Y + 1, cell(Y, X1, D), X1 = X - 1, cell(Y, X2, E), X2 = X + 1.

why: one 3x3 ring of 4 (centre transparent) centred on the line intersection; all other cells unchanged

reading: Two 3x3 2-frames with a 5 centre each have one gap; a band of 4 is filled from each gap out and across the space between the two frames, joining them, without overwriting the frames.

slots.subjects: the two 3x3 frames with a 5 centre
slots.openings: the missing ring cell of each frame and its outward direction
slots.region: the gap cells plus the rectangular corridor between the frames spanning from one opening's line to the other's, coloured 4

why: only background cells (and the gap cells) become 4; the 4 region is connected and touches both openings

reading: From the 2 on the bottom row a 2-coloured staircase (two cells per row) climbs up-right to the top/right edge, sidestepping around any 1 cells it meets.

slots.source: the 2 cell on the bottom row
slots.path: diagonal up-right staircase: each row up, the cell above and its right neighbour are 2
slots.obstacle: 1 cells: the path shifts right to pass them without overwriting

why: every row above the source holds the staircase cells in colour 2; 1 cells stay unchanged
